reason: Harness 1.0 removes the 0.x deprecation shims (#12997): `pydantic_ai_harness.repo_context._capability`, RepoContext.__init__(nested_max_chars): Parameter kind was changed: positional or keyword -> keyword-only. Each removed path emitted a `HarnessDeprecationWarning` naming its replacement during 0.x. The options after a removed positional field are keyword-only, so an old positional call fails instead of shifting onto the next field.
